text:
MGN 586 (F) Amendment 3 ILO work in fishing convention, 2007 - medical care
If a fisherman requires medical care while working on a fishing vessel they must receive this free of charge and costs rest with the fishing vessel owner.
Documents
Details
This notice should be read with the The Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018 and replaces MGN 586 (F) amendment 2.
Amendment 3 updates references only.
Notice to
- fishing vessel owners
- operators and managers
- employers of fishermen
- skippers
- officers and fishermen on fishing vessels.
Please email workinfishing.convention@mcga.gov.uk with any enquiries.
